plain.li: [ail:FluCough] The flu's gone and left its cough behind. I woke the whole room twice last night.
[ail:FluCough] Everyone says I look better. Then I start coughing and they step back.
[ail:PlagueSwellings] The fever's gone. The lumps under my arms are still there, tender as bruises.
[ail:PlagueSwellings] They tell me I've beaten the plague. I'd feel more like celebrating if I could lift my arms.
[ail:Limp] The leg has knit. It just hasn't been told yet. I limp to the table and limp back.
[ail:Limp] Walked the length of the yard today and had to sit on the woodpile. The bone's fine, they say. The rest of the leg disagrees.
[ail:BurnItch] The burn has healed into shiny new skin that itches all day. I sit on my hands.
[ail:BadNights] Haven't slept properly since the fight. Every door that bangs is the raid again.
[ail:BadNights] Woke in the dark with my hand on my knife and no idea why. Then I remembered.
[ail:BadNights,child] I had bad dreams about the raiders. I went and slept on the floor by the fire.
[ail:Unease] I keep looking at the corners of rooms. There's nothing there. I keep looking anyway.
[ail:Unease] I left a lamp burning all night and didn't care who saw it.
[ail:PollutionCough] A day out on the bad ground, and now I cough up grey and taste metal.
[ail:PollutionCough] The haze was down all afternoon. My throat feels sanded.
[ail:SnowBlind] Too long out on the snow under that sun. My eyes are red and full of grit, and I can't bear the lamp.
[ail:SnowBlind] Snow-blind, they call it. I spent the evening with a wet cloth over my eyes, listening to everyone else eat.
[ail:Leeches] Came out of the swamp with three leeches behind my knee. I didn't feel a thing until I saw them.
[ail:Leeches,child] There were leeches on my legs! Big ones. They put salt on them and they fell off.
[ail:OrbitSick] My stomach doesn't believe we're up here. Neither do I, when I look out of the window.
[ail:OrbitSick] Headache, no appetite, and the stars keep moving. Orbit sick, the others say. It passes.

cheerful.li: [ail:Limp] Limping, but walking! Which is more than I was doing a month ago.
[ail:Leeches] Leeches. Well, now I've had leeches.

gloomy.li: [ail:BadNights] The fight's over. It just hasn't stopped happening at night.
[ail:Unease] Some things you can't stop seeing.

cold.li: [ail:BadNights] Disturbed sleep after the engagement. It should pass within the week.
[ail:SnowBlind] Inflamed eyes from the glare. Goggles in future.

plain.li: [ail:SwampFever] A fever out of nowhere, red eyes, and my calves ache as if I'd walked for a week. They say it was the swamp water.
[ail:SwampFever] I looked at my hands this morning and they'd gone yellow. The doctor didn't say anything, which was worse.
[ail:FluCough] Got through a whole night without coughing. The others say the same.
[ail:PlagueSwellings] The swellings have gone down at last. I can lift my arms over my head again.
[ail:Limp] Ran across the yard today without thinking about it. The leg's mine again.
[ail:BurnItch] The burn has stopped itching. It's just a pale patch now.
[ail:BadNights] Slept through the night. No raiders, no doors banging. Just sleep.
[ail:Unease] Walked past the dark end of the storeroom today without looking. I only noticed afterwards.
[ail:SnowBlind] I can look at the snow again. I'm wearing the goggles anyway.
[ail:OrbitSick] Ate a whole meal and didn't think about the stars once. I think my body's given in.
[ail:SwampFever] The yellow's going out of my skin, and I kept down a full bowl of broth. I'm not going near that water again.

cheerful.li: [ail:Limp] No more limp! I may have done a small dance about it.

plain.li: [ail:FluCough] Gave {OTHER_nameDef} something for the cough the flu left behind. It's the lungs healing; it'll take its time.
[ail:PlagueSwellings] Dressed the swellings the plague left on {OTHER_nameDef}. They're going down.
[ail:Limp] Strapped {OTHER_nameDef}'s healed leg and showed {OTHER_objective} the exercises. Walking, not bed.
[ail:BurnItch] Put salve on {OTHER_nameDef}'s healed burn and told {OTHER_objective} not to scratch it; {OTHER_pronoun} scratched it on the way out.
[ail:SnowBlind] Bathed {OTHER_nameDef}'s eyes and sat {OTHER_objective} in the dark. Goggles next time.
[ail:Leeches] Took four leeches off {OTHER_nameDef} with a pinch of salt each, and {OTHER_pronoun} wouldn't look.
[ail:PollutionCough] Steam and a clean cloth for {OTHER_nameDef}'s cough. We need masks for whoever works the bad ground.
[ail:OrbitSick] Gave {OTHER_nameDef} something for the stomach and told {OTHER_objective} to eat plain food and sleep at the same hours.
[ail:SwampFever] Tended {OTHER_nameDef}'s fever twice since noon. The skin's going yellow; I'm watching the kidneys.
[ail:SwampFever] The yellow has gone out of {OTHER_nameDef}'s skin. Whatever the swamp put in {OTHER_objective}, we got it out.
[ail:FluCough] It's only the cough the flu left, I'm not catching.
[ail:PlagueSwellings] Don't hug me yet, the swellings are still sore.
[ail:Limp] Go on ahead, I'll catch up slowly.
[ail:BurnItch] Tell me if I start scratching this burn again.
[ail:BadNights] Sorry, I'm half asleep after another bad night.
[ail:BadNights] Did you hear something just then?
[ail:Unease] Can we leave the lamp on tonight?
[ail:Unease] Don't come up behind me like that.
[ail:PollutionCough] Everything out on the bad ground tastes of metal.
[ail:SnowBlind] I can't see a thing, the light's like needles.
[ail:Leeches] Tell me there isn't still a leech on me.
[ail:OrbitSick] Don't mention food, or the windows.
[ail:SwampFever] Don't ever go into that swamp water barefoot.
